notes: The supplied text (catalog pages 64-66) does not contain a section for the Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement. It prints General Studies degree Areas of Emphasis: the tail of a list whose heading is cut off (its note refers to LACCD GE Area 3, likely Arts and Humanities), 'Natural Sciences' and 'Social and Behavioral Sciences' (cut off at SOC 003). Each is a separate 60-unit degree with 'LACCD GE OR CAL-GETC PATTERN' and an 18-unit Area of Emphasis rule ('No more than two courses from any one subject area').

Because these lists belong to General Studies degrees, not to the named Cal-GETC certificate, no blocks, totals or GE fields were recorded for this award. section_heading gives only the page running head 'General Studies Degrees'. A reviewer should locate the actual Cal-GETC certificate section in the 2026-2027 ELAC catalog; the source page reference may be wrong.
The closed list looks like the Cal-GETC approved course list. Its courses appear in the text only as General Studies emphasis options.

Part 2: The supplied text (catalog pages 64-66) holds only General Studies degree Areas of Emphasis (end of Arts and Humanities list, Natural Sciences, Social and Behavioral Sciences); no section for the Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement appears, so no blocks are recorded.
Part 2: The 'Total 60' and 'LACCD GE OR CAL-GETC PATTERN' lines belong to the General Studies A.A. degrees, not this certificate, so degree_total, ge_units and ge_pattern are left null.
Part 2: The text is cut off mid-list at SOC 003 on page 66; the Cal-GETC certificate section likely appears elsewhere in the catalog and should be checked.
